specific_concerns: The admissible record supports aggregate pass and slice underperformance, but it does not show that the required disclosure has actually been made; the recommendation depends on a condition not yet evidenced.

evidence_requests: Provide the final model-card or certification text showing explicit disclosure of the small-business support slice weakness, the lack of approved mitigation, and the follow-up confirmation caveat.
Provide admissible evidence that the small-business support slice qualifies as a protected or contractual customer segment, or other evidence establishing materiality under policy.

decision_criteria: Aggregate performance may support launch readiness but does not erase subgroup weaknesses.
Certification may proceed only if material weaknesses are disclosed or an approved mitigation removes deployment exposure.
An unreviewed draft mitigation does not satisfy the approved-mitigation path.
Sampling uncertainty can justify caution and retesting, but it does not convert an unresolved weakness into a clean pass.
A compliant certification recommendation must carry the required disclosure predicate, not imply unconditional certification.
